title: Sender Delegation — payload
description: The document's signer (this document's `issuer`) names the one transport sender permitted to carry the listed Trust Task documents to this document's `recipient`. It confers no authority on the sender: the consumer still authorizes each carried document as its own issuer. Short-lived by construction — the document's `expiresAt` is REQUIRED and at most 300 seconds after its `issuedAt`.

delegate.description: The bare DID (no fragment) of the transport sender permitted to carry the listed documents. A consumer compares it by exact string equality against the transport-authenticated sender of the message that carried them.

documents.description: The `id` of each Trust Task document this delegation covers. A carried document whose `id` is not listed is not covered, however recently the delegation was issued.
